title: Documenting Patterns of Exoticism of Marginalized Populations within Text-to-Image Generators
reasoning: The paper evaluates religious bias as a core component of its study, specifically comparing the AI-generated representations of Indian Muslims versus Hindus (e.g., the stereotypical association of religious headgear). It also addresses caste hierarchies, which have religious foundations, and advocates for the inclusion of decolonial and non-Western epistemologies in AI design.
